title: Domain restriction preserves integer multiplicity
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ and U, W ⊆ ℝ^P with W ⊆ U and W open. If Y ∈ D_k(U) is an integer multiplicity current, then its restriction Y|_W ∈ D_k(W), Y|_W(ω) := Y(ω) for ω ∈ D^k(W) ⊆ D^k(U) (SimonGMT GeometricCurrentOn.restrictDomain), is an integer multiplicity current.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)) (hWU : W ⊆ U), IsOpen W → ∀ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U k, IsIntegerMultiplicity Y → IsIntegerMultiplicity (Y.restrictDomain hWU)
